label: Regional prices, local wages
_note: A reconstruction, not a measurement. Prices are BLS average prices for the South Census region (urban), all brands and outlets; wages are QCEW for each SC county. Quantities come from the standard basket (collection.json basket_file), so the household matches the measured series. Only concepts with a like-for-like BLS series are included; the rest are listed under excluded with the reason.

imputation._note: A missing South price moves with the same item's U.S. city average month-over-month change (BLS-style cell-relative imputation); if that is missing too, with the geometric-mean change of the concepts BLS did publish for the South that month (the all-strata fallback of ADR 0002). Only in a month with nothing published at all is the last price carried, at most max_carry_months. A concept imputed longer than max_impute_months is unpriced, and so is its month.

excluded.peanut_butter: BLS peanut butter series (716141) not published for the South

excluded.cola_2l: the South 2-liter soft drink series (FN1101) begins 2018-04; including it would cut the history to 2018
excluded.coffee_ground: the South coffee series (717311) is published only 2021-05 to 2025-09
